items.name: Prism (this repository)
items.notes: Prism's own code, tokens, specs and docs, proprietary since 2026-09-22: all rights reserved, no use, copying, modification or distribution without the copyright holder's written permission (ADR-0031, which supersedes ADR-0028). No SPDX identifier exists for it, so this ledger uses a LicenseRef-* and the npm manifests carry npm's own form for a license shipped with the package, "SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE". Versions published under MIT before 2026-09-22 stay MIT for those versions. The packaged_as globs are the license copies ADR-0031 rule 1 requires, the generated @font-face sheets and the generated asset-catalog metadata; every third-party item below keeps its own license, bundled with its license text, and LICENSE takes nothing away from those.

items.name: Onest
items.notes: Signature preset ui/display. Bundle OFL.txt next to the font. OFL 1.1 permits bundling with any software, proprietary software included, so long as each copy carries the copyright notice and the license (OFL condition 2) and the font is never sold by itself (condition 1); no Reserved Font Name is declared for this family, and condition 5 keeps the font itself under the OFL whatever LICENSE says about Prism. The web face is a Modified Version under the OFL — tools/tokens/formats/fonts.ts re-encodes the upstream TTF to woff2, a format change — presented under the original family name in fonts.css; that is lawful precisely because no Reserved Font Name is declared, and it would stop being lawful if the family ever declared one upstream (OFL condition 3, with TERMINATION attached).

items.name: JetBrains Mono
items.attribution: Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors
items.notes: Signature preset mono; google/fonts build, pinned by ADR-0021. Same OFL terms as Onest: bundling inside proprietary software is permitted with the notice and the license beside it, the font is never sold by itself, and no Reserved Font Name is declared. The web face is a Modified Version under the OFL — tools/tokens/formats/fonts.ts re-encodes the upstream TTF to woff2, a format change — presented under the original family name in fonts.css; that is lawful precisely because no Reserved Font Name is declared, and it would stop being lawful if the family ever declared one upstream (OFL condition 3, with TERMINATION attached).

items.name: Inter
items.notes: Native preset, web only: self-hosted woff2 built from upstream InterVariable.ttf in brands/prism-native/fonts/inter/ (from the Inter-4.1.zip release asset, whose LICENSE.txt is the OFL.txt beside it); never loaded from Google Fonts (ADR-0020). The woff2 build is a Modified Version under the OFL (a format change), which the OFL allows because no Reserved Font Name is declared; it ships under the OFL with its text beside it, and is never sold by itself.

items.name: Phosphor Icons
items.notes: The image sets of swift/Sources/DSIcons are the SVG sources of @phosphor-icons/core 2.1.1, copied byte for byte by icons:build (P2-2, ADR-0013), redistributed with the package's MIT text as Phosphor-LICENSE.txt beside them. The web side ships names only (web/packages/react/src/generated/icons.ts), rendered by @phosphor-icons/react in the consuming app. MIT permits redistribution inside a proprietary work without restriction, provided the copyright notice and the permission notice travel with the copies, which Phosphor-LICENSE.txt does.

items.name: SF Symbols 7
items.notes: System-provided images drawn by the OS at run time under the Xcode and SDK license: Swift code names a symbol, no bytes are copied or bundled. Never in the web package, docs, Tokens Studio export or Figma web frames (ADR-0013 rule 5), and never in app icons, logos or other trademark-like use.

items.name: SF Pro / SF Compact / SF Mono
items.notes: Reached through Font.system on Apple platforms, where the OS provides the faces (ADR-0021); never bundled and never served on the web. The downloadable SF font files stay under the Apple Font license, which permits mock-ups of Apple-platform interfaces only.

items.name: Adobe spectrum-design-data
items.notes: Reference for component schemas and token data structure; NOTICE preserved if adapted.

items.name: DTCG Format and Resolver JSON Schemas
items.notes: format.json and resolver.json as published at designtokens.org/schemas/2025.10 (the schemas/ package of the source repository), vendored byte-identical in tools/tokens/schema/dtcg-2025.10/ with LICENSE.md (the full W3C Software and Document Notice and License) and SHA256SUMS; tokens:validate reads them offline and no Prism package ships them (ADR-0024 §10). The source repository licenses its reports under the W3C Software and Document License and takes contributed software under the W3C 3-clause BSD License. That license permits copying and distribution "for any purpose and without fee or royalty", proprietary purposes included, provided the full notice, any pre-existing disclaimers and a note of any changes travel with every copy; LICENSE.md carries the notice and Prism made no changes.

items.name: React and React DOM
items.attribution: Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates.
items.notes: Peer dependency of every published web package (ADR-0019); the consuming app installs it, and Prism ships none of its bytes.

items.name: React Aria Components
items.notes: Behavior and accessibility layer of @iiiivaska/prism-react (roadmap P3-4, docs/research/arch-web.md); a runtime dependency, never vendored. The Apache NOTICE is preserved if any source is ever adapted.

items.name: visx
items.notes: Chart primitives of @iiiivaska/prism-charts (ADR-0007, roadmap Phase 4); a runtime dependency of the published package once the charts land.

items.name: d3-shape
items.notes: Path generators behind the chart curves (ADR-0007); shared with visx, which depends on the same module.

items.name: d3-scale
items.notes: Scale math behind the chart axes (ADR-0007); shared with visx.

items.name: Motion
items.notes: Spring solver of tools/tokens/transforms/spring.ts at build time (ADR-0023) and the web motion runtime from roadmap P3-4; its bytes never enter a Prism package.

items.name: Style Dictionary
items.attribution: Style Dictionary, Copyright Style Dictionary Contributors. Apache License 2.0
items.notes: Build-time token engine of tools/tokens (ADR-0004, ARCHITECTURE §3); it produces Prism's own generated files and ships in no package. The NOTICE is preserved if any source is adapted.

items.name: woff2-encoder
items.notes: Build-time encoder of tools/tokens/formats/fonts.ts: it produces every woff2 byte Prism ships, from the OFL TTFs in brands/*/fonts. It ships in no package, and its MIT terms attach to the encoder, not to its output — the output stays under the font's own OFL (finding F-2, docs/legal-checkpoint.md §2.5).

items.name: swift-snapshot-testing
items.notes: Test-only SwiftPM dependency of DSSnapshotTests (Package.swift); SwiftPM does not resolve it for consumers of the Prism libraries, and no product links it.
